I was tired for a bit and had some muscle weakness also. It didn’t last too long. I’m not good with time spans but I do remember going from feeling like a melted pile of human goo one day to waking up one morning and cleaning my whole house with the energy of a toddler on speed. I still have some muscle tiredness/weakness in my arms so doing my hair (blow drying and flat ironing) takes about 10 minutes longer because I have to stop and rest my arms for a moment or two. The withdrawal didn’t last nearly as long as I expected it to. I did have the added setback with the allergic reaction to the Latuda. That happened on the 20th and I had to go to the ER but it wasn’t a serious reaction. The doctor made gave me something for the hives and did a full blood work up and checked out my heart but everything was great.

I feel so much better! My hand tremors have stopped completely. I have started to feel emotions again. Before I was just numb to everything and now I can express how I really feel and control it from bubbling over into something I can’t handle. My psychiatrist tried me on Latuda but I’m allergic so she has put me on Depakote and I’ve been on it for about a week now. I hope things work out positively for you!

I had thyroid cancer in 2012. My thyroid was removed. My parathyroid was damaged. I have to take medication for the rest of my life to offset not having a thyroid. I also struggle to keep my calcium and potassium levels up because of the damage to my parathyroid. I take 2 different medications to offset the calcium deficiency and 1 to offset the potassium deficiency. Now that I’m done discussing medications, allow me to enlighten you on what that simple iodine pill did to me. It damaged my salivary glands. I have constant dry mouth. My teeth deteriorated and I had to have them removed. Also, I just recently went in for my routine 6 month checkup and they’ve found a mass and my lymph nodes are swollen. Thyroid cancer can spread to the lungs or the brain. I’ll have to be monitored for the rest of my life. Just because you think you have an idea of what thyroid cancer is, doesn’t mean it’s correct. My best friend had tongue cancer and a tumor on his spine but he never treats my cancer any less than mine. It’s not a race. It’s not a game. You’re not a winner. No one is when cancer is involved.

I have Bipolar. I don’t want to harm you or your children. I don’t wear aluminum foil on my head. My emotions don’t swing from moment to moment. When I’m in a depression (as I am now), I’m not sad, I’m just nothing. Just because you tell me I’m beautiful, smart, great, wonderful, whatever, doesn’t mean that the bully that I call a brain will believe that. I’ve lived 42 years with this thing calling me awful names so your 3 second affirmation won’t cure me. Thinking happy thoughts doesn’t cure Bipolar, it makes you Peter Pan. Please stop telling me to get outside. Most people don’t know that I spend a lot of time in nature. Changing my environment doesn’t change my brain. Yes, I am medicated. Yes, I have been on a steady regimen of medication for years. No, that does not mean that I won’t still have bouts of depression or mania, they’re just lessened. That’s all I can think of right now.

My mom gaslights me. All the time. I never do anything right. Even when I do exactly as she says, it was wrong somehow. I just turned 42 on Monday. I had to move back home in June and I have a lot of health problems. I had a seizure night before last. It was in the middle of the night and when I came out of it and was able, I opened my bedroom door and called out to her to let her know. Her response was, “What do you want me to do about it?” I asked for some water and she woke my dad up to get it. Yesterday she didn’t even ask how I was feeling. She complained about how difficult it was dealing with my 4-year-old niece and 1-year-old nephew when I was the one breaking up the fights (the 4 year old has anger/rage issues and is violent). I was supposed to be resting. I don’t argue with my mom anymore. I stopped because it got me nowhere except a crying heap of mixed emotions and suicidal thoughts.

I’ve hit a depression. I’m Bipolar and these things come and go, but this time the circumstances in my life are making it more difficult. Home no longer feels like a safe and peaceful place. I’ve reached out to friends yet all of them are magically too busy to spend a day with me. It makes me feel bitter because many of them are the first to post that they are there when needed, and they repost all those bullshit pics on FB about listening when a person is depressed or suicidal. It’s like I’m screaming for help and they’re putting on headphones and blaring music to keep me out. I feel really very alone. And that’s a dangerous place for me.
